items.summary: Michigan Strategic FundがJ.R. Automation Technologies(Zeeland, MI)に対し、最大$72.8Mの投資・150人の新規雇用計画に対しMBDPパフォーマンス型助成金として最大$1.6Mを承認。J.R. Automationは産業用自動化・ロボットシステムを手掛ける機械メーカー。

items.verbatim: Michigan Strategic Fund approved a Michigan Business Development Program Performance Based Grant on 2025-09-30. Location: Zeeland. Projected investment: Up to $72.80 million. Projected jobs: 150. Projected award: Up to $1.60 million.
